description:
Create a custom 'Green Roof' construction and assign it to the 4StoreyBuilding model. You must define three new MATERIALS, one new CONSTRUCTION, and assign it to all ROOF surfaces.

1. Define 3 New Materials in the Library:
   - Name: 'GR-Soil-4in' | Thickness: 0.333 ft | Conductivity: 0.42 | Density: 75.0 | Specific Heat: 0.25
   - Name: 'GR-Drainage-Mat' | Thickness: 0.042 ft | Conductivity: 0.03 | Density: 2.5 | Specific Heat: 0.35
   - Name: 'GR-Insulation-R20' | Thickness: 0.333 ft | Conductivity: 0.017 | Density: 1.5 | Specific Heat: 0.25

2. Create a New Construction:
   - Name: 'Green-Roof-Assembly'
   - Layers (Outside to Inside): 'GR-Soil-4in', 'GR-Drainage-Mat', 'GR-Insulation-R20'

3. Assign 'Green-Roof-Assembly' to ALL Roof surfaces in the building.

4. Run the annual simulation and save the project.
